fato_historico: 1863: The last Thursday in November is declared as Thanksgiving Day by U.S. President Abraham Lincoln.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an inviting warmth as the cosmic energy encourages a spirit of unity. Just as a presidential decree once carved out a special moment for collective thanksgiving, it is a good time to gather your blessings. Consider how your relationships flourish when you express genuine appreciation for the people who color your world with joy.
frase_do_dia: A grateful heart is a magnet for miracles and lasting peace.
significado_numero: A powerful master number representing intuition and spiritual alignment.
conselho: Take time to share a heartfelt word of thanks with someone special today.
